music.prompt: Crisp shuffled UK garage percussion at 130 BPM starting instantly on the first beat: swung 2-step hi-hats, rimshots, finger snaps and a muted kick, tight and bouncy, with a light rising filter sweep building toward the end. Percussion only: no melody, no chords, no bass notes, no vocals.

High-energy UK garage 2-step track at 130 BPM that starts immediately at full energy on the very first beat, no intro and no fade-in: swung shuffled drums, punchy kick and crisp snare, a warm bouncing sub bass, bright chopped organ stabs and a catchy plucked synth hook. Confident and playful, like a modern product launch. Full energy all the way through with no breakdown and no big ending hit; the groove just keeps rolling. No vocals, no singing.
